design: Seven patterns at half and 0.98 scale: unequal tones cover both channel frequencies; same/opposite and each hard-pan cover stereo extremes; silence-separated impulse and abrupt tone gates cover transients; PCG64(seed0xD0C70B12) uniform independent noise covers broadband quantization. This is a bounded set, not a Cartesian sweep.
limits: Known1057sample lag is fixed from previous nonperiodic proof; no gain compensation applied.
All decoded float samples are checked before signed16 conversion; outside-unit counts indicate potential downstream clipping, not automatically integer overflow.
Steady metrics exclude4608source samples at both edges; isolated impulse and gate metrics retain transients.
This probe does not drain finite-stream tails or verify tail preservation.
No listening, music transparency, calibrated analog path, firmware timing, transport or endurance claim.
Finite fixtures cannot establish a worst-case all-input integer bound.

acceptance_recommendation.status: Headroom acceptance blocked; do not call current MP3 full-range fidelity production-ready.
acceptance_recommendation.severity: High: legal signed16 nearfull tonal PCM overflows MDCT intermediate sums and final stored coefficients; severe waveform damage.
acceptance_recommendation.fix_before_shipping: Choose a representation that safely holds every legal PCM transform coefficient and accumulation prefix while preserving decoder unity gain, then verify derived all-input bounds and actual adversarial fixtures. Widening the accumulator alone is insufficient. Parent owns that design/fix decision.
acceptance_recommendation.separate_clipping_issue: Nearfull independent noise has zero observed encoder addition wrap and no signed-overflow sanitizer error but decoded float peaks1.5399/1.5073. Define acceptable decoded overshoot/downstream clipping separately; do not mislabel this as the tone integer overflow.
acceptance_recommendation.half_scale_limit: All seven half-scale float fixtures stay inside[-1,1]; this finite result is not a universal safe-input guarantee or an approved external attenuation policy.
acceptance_recommendation.preexisting: Exact unmodified pinned upstream fails the same0.98tone sanitizer control; the8/9 normalization reduces coefficient magnitudes and did not introduce this measured class of defect.
